plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-SELF2): Checklist, done, handoff and worker report tools
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: W-SELF1 gave the dashboard a self-caller resolver and a job store, but no route starts a job, so agents still run pan task, pan done, pan handoff and pan worker report through Bash with the admin internal token. W-SELF1 also gives a conversation job no OVERDECK_AGENT_ID, so pan handoff self cannot find its conversation and a conversation claim is recorded as a dead cli-<pid>.
narratives.Proposal: Add src/dashboard/server/routes/self-workflow.ts with six POST /api/self/ routes (tasks/claim, tasks/done, tasks/block, done, handoff, worker-report) that take the agent and issue from the agent token, build argv only with buildSelfJobArgv pieces, start a W-SELF1 job, wait up to 50 s and answer selfJobAnswer; add six audience-agent MCP tools in tools-self.ts that pass the answer through; set OVERDECK_AGENT_ID=<tmuxSession> for conversation jobs; document the tools and routes. PRD: .pan/drafts/PAN-4937.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No --steal on task_claim and no task_unblock, task_reopen, task_cancel, task_next or task_show tools
- No done options: --comment, --force, --test-waived and --strike are never passed
- No handoff options other than focus and title; never --cwd, --allow-primary, --model, --effort, --issue, --role, --fresh, --hold, skills, packs or author choice
- No conversation-row or primary-checkout pre-check in the handoff route
- No worker report --file and no reporting for another worker
- No lane report, memory or secret routes (W-DEL1, W-MEM1, W-SEC1); no MCP injection (W-INJ1-3); no instructions block (W-INJ4)
- No parsing of job JSON stdout in routes or tools; no isError for a non-zero exitCode
- No change to self-caller.ts, self-job-argv.ts or the W-SELF1 wait route; the only W-SELF1 change is the conversation env in selfJobEnv
- No CSRF or Content-Type check on the self workflow routes
- No change to the visibility.test.ts assertions (13 non-agent tools; [list_machines, wait_job] for a read:state agent)

autoDecisions.summary: Handoff passes the literal ref self, and selfJobEnv gives a conversation caller OVERDECK_AGENT_ID=<tmuxSession>
autoDecisions.rationale: Conversation names such as conv-flywheel~0d0028ec fail SELF_JOB_REF_PATTERN; self resolves through OVERDECK_AGENT_ID exactly as in the conversation shell (conversation-runtime.ts:806-812), and the same variable makes task claim record conv-<name> instead of a dead cli-<pid>.

autoDecisions.summary: No route pre-check for a missing conversation row or a primary-checkout cwd on handoff
autoDecisions.rationale: The CLI stays the one door; a work agent gets pan handoff exit 1, and an inherited cwd matches pan handoff self today (conversation-forks.ts checks only an explicit cwd).

autoDecisions.summary: All six routes in one file, delivered as a sequential chain of vertical slices
autoDecisions.rationale: Every slice appends to the same route file, scope table, no-loss matrix, tool list and enumerating tests, so they share mutations whatever the file split.

autoDecisions.summary: Tools pass a finished job with a non-zero exitCode through as a normal result
autoDecisions.rationale: wait_job already passes it through (W-SELF1 D-3), so the first call and every wait_job answer the same way.

autoDecisions.summary: task_block on is optional; done takes no options; worker_report requires status
autoDecisions.rationale: runTaskBlock without --on is a real plain block; the epic body for done is {}; the epic table lists status for worker_report.

autoDecisions.summary: Started jobs answer HTTP 200 for both done and running
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the W-SELF1 wait route; routeResult treats every 2xx alike.

autoDecisions.summary: No CSRF or Content-Type check on self workflow routes
autoDecisions.rationale: Only a header-borne agent token is accepted, and rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest skips CSRF for token credentials (dashboard-auth.ts:277).

metadata.acJustification: Five criteria: the argv shape, hostile flag text, field limits, the --yolo pre-parse guard and the conversation env each fail independently.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. Add handleSelfHandoff: required focus (non-empty, at most 10,000 chars), optional title (non-empty, at most 200 chars); argv handoff self [--title=<title>] -- <focus>; never --cwd or --allow-primary; no issue check. Register POST /api/self/handoff, scope row tell, no-loss row, handoff tool with the PRD description; tests including the conversation-caller env check that depends on job-env-conversation-id. Also refuse with 400 bad-request a focus matching /^--(?:no-)?yolo(?:=|$)/, because the pan CLI pre-parse at src/cli/index.ts:60-86 removes such an element from argv even after -- and sets PAN_YOLO (permission mode).
